definition: a place full of books you can read or borrow
description: A huge old library at night during a thunderstorm. Tall dark wooden bookshelves full of books rise up both walls to galleries with iron railings, and a rolling brass ladder stands by the shelves. A long reading table with green desk lamps runs down the left side. Through a tall Gothic window with a round rose window, bright lightning flashes outside. A white barn owl flies towards the viewer with spread wings as loose sheets of paper flutter down, and lands on top of the ladder, where it folds its wings and sits.

en.question: What is the barn owl doing?
